protocol.frozen_models: C71 all four onset classifiers/case and strong reference;no new tree/neural fitting
protocol.calibration: Previously unused15day checkpoint buffer,both arms before decision,same balanced30/condition spacing360 seed4129 public-observation sampler. Fit only eligible onset last-step rows,window-equal weighted logloss +.01/2*((slope-1)^2+intercept^2),slope[.05,5],intercept[-8,8],clip1e-6. Fewer3windows/missingclass ->identity. No tuning regularization/bounds.
protocol.IoU: Own exact suffix Bernoulli convolution,all k0..N;empty/empty=1. Conditional independence and full-domain risk are modeling assumptions,not true traffic label independence or future scoring-mask knowledge. Nonempty arm forbidsk0 only,does not claim scored positives guaranteed.
protocol.decision: Reuse C71 decision arrays/featurearm,raw threshold is frozen C71. Cal threshold31grid.05..8 x forceFalse/True,prefer noforce/closer.5. Choose max ORDER,incumbent first.
protocol.selection: Same later15days and3eventseeds:challenger needs origin macro gain>=.01,7dayblock95CI lower>0;else incumbent. Seal before assessment.
protocol.limits: Previously available/partly viewed public proxy calendars;new calibration data and fit,not blind/private/final. Old2196raw audit explicitly reused;new calibration raw will be verified separately. No future eligibility input to decoding.
